assertions.assertion: CO-197 indicates the required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the service date
The clinical indication documents recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope associated with palpitations
raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
the intermittent nature of these symptoms and the need for continuous rhythm correlation during daily activities warrant mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring to capture potential arrhythmic events
The ordered procedure for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is consistent with the documented diagnosis codes R55 and I47.1
and the stated need to correlate intermittent symptoms with rhythm
